jobs.name: ss-before
jobs.prompt: IDENTITY: the two reference photographs show ONE woman, the HNK model — keep her EXACT face in every detail: a slim oval face that narrows to a small, softly pointed chin; large, round-leaning almond eyes set a touch wide, with a deep double eyelid crease, a light warm-brown iris and long heavy lashes under a soft winged liner; straight brows with a low gentle arch, darker and fuller than average; a small nose, narrow at the bridge, neat and rounded at the tip; FULL lips with a distinctly fuller lower lip, a sharply drawn cupid's bow and a deep rose-red lip colour; high rounded cheekbones with a warm pink blush; fair porcelain skin, early twenties. Same person, same face shape, same eyes, nose, lips and jawline as the references — do not redesign, slim, age, harden or replace her. IGNORE in the references and copy NONE of it: the silver headdress, the silver earrings, the embroidered collar, her clothing and the sky behind her — only the face. Create a full-length studio photograph of the HNK model from the references (the same face, fair luminous porcelain skin, long dark hair worn loose, soft natural glam, early twenties, slim, elegant), standing in a bright warm-cream photo studio with a plain seamless cream backdrop and a matte pale-oak floor, wearing an ivory satin off-shoulder gown, her body turned slightly to her left, smiling gently at the camera, her RIGHT hand resting lightly on the top of a PLAIN LOW WOODEN STOOL (a simple round seat on four straight legs, bare pale wood, no cushion, no decoration) that stands beside her on her right at hip height; soft even window light from the front-left, a gentle floor shadow under her and under the stool, 50mm lens at chest height, HORIZONTAL 3:2 framing with the woman in the left two thirds and the stool in the right third with open studio room around it, no photographic equipment anywhere in the frame, photoreal, no text, no captions, no watermark, no logo.

jobs.name: ss-after
jobs.prompt:
You are editing the user's SELECTED AREA of a photograph (in Photoshop this is the exact rectangle they selected; on the web it is the rectangle drawn on the photo, or the whole photo when none was drawn). Make ONLY the change the MODE line asks, inside this area, and change absolutely nothing else — the photograph's crop, composition and every pixel outside the area stay exactly as photographed.
MODE: REPLACE — remove whatever occupies the selected area and put THE NEW OBJECT in its place, on the same spot and footprint, keeping the same point of contact with any hand or body that touched the old object, and rebuild whatever the old object hid (floor, wall, backdrop, fabric) where the new one does not cover it.
OBJECT: a cream velvet armchair with slim gold legs
SIZE & PLACEMENT: the same footprint as the stool, her hand resting on the top of its back
THE NEW OBJECT: when IMAGE 2 is given, it is the exact item shown in IMAGE 2 — its shape, proportions, colour, pattern, material and finish — and nothing else from IMAGE 2 (never its background, floor, light, people, text or logo, and never IMAGE 2 returned as the result). Otherwise it is what the OBJECT line names, drawn as a real photographed item of that kind. With no IMAGE 2 and no OBJECT line, act as MODE FILL: rebuild the area from its surroundings and put nothing new in.
MATCH: draw the object at the photograph's camera height and viewing angle, in true perspective with the surface it rests on, at a believable real-world size against the people and objects near it, with true contact with that surface, and with the photograph's own light direction, colour grade, white balance, grain and sharpness on it.
SHADOW: the object casts the shadow such an object would cast in this light, onto the floor, wall or surface it touches, and shows in any reflective surface nearby.
PRESERVE: everything inside the area that the MODE line does not name stays exactly as photographed — every person's face, skin, hair, hands, pose and outfit, every other object, the same materials and textures; identical white balance, exposure, lighting direction and colour grade, so the edited area drops back into the full photograph with no visible seam. Where the object passes behind a person or an object that stays, they remain in front with clean edges.
EDGE RULE: keep the outermost few pixels of the area as close to the original as the change allows, so any paste-back edge is invisible.
The result must be photorealistic and read as the SAME photograph with only the requested change made.

AVOID: changed composition, re-cropped, zoomed, changed identity, changed face, changed pose, changed hands, changed outfit, colour shift outside the request, white balance shift, lighting change, a second object where one was asked, the old object left behind in REPLACE or FILL, the object removed in ADD or CHANGE, wrong scale, floating object, missing contact shadow, object covering a face or a hand, IMAGE 2's background, IMAGE 2 returned as the result, a different item than IMAGE 2, blur, seam, border, vignette, watermark, text, logo.
